raw_block.rationale: Create a focused terminal helper for statutory subclause claims involving payments made upon or after termination. It separates current-case fact reading from the source-grounded timing and qualifying-cause rule, preventing the observed fallback from overlooking disability retirement.

inputs.name: payment_upon_or_after_termination
inputs.question: Was the payment described in the current facts made upon or after termination of the employment relationship?

inputs.name: termination_cause
inputs.question: What caused the employment relationship to terminate in the current facts? Normalize the result as death, disability_retirement, or other.

skill.intent: Determine whether a payment satisfies a termination-payment subclause requiring payment upon or after termination because of death or retirement for disability, and return the native binary entailment label.

outputs.description: The native label Entailment or Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer
